targets.authors: Fernbach, P. M., Rogers, T., Fox, C. R., & Sloman, S. A.
targets.title: Political extremism is supported by an illusion of understanding.
targets.evidence_quote:
Given the practical importance of these findings, we conducted two preregistered close replications of Fernbach et al.’s
Experiment 2 (Replication 1a: N = 306; Replication 1b: N = 405) and preregistered close and conceptual replications
of Fernbach et al.’s Experiment 3 (Replication 2: N = 343).
targets.outcome_quote:
Given the importance of reducing political extremism, the failure of these replications to produce evidence that mechanistic explanations for policy positions
reduce political extremism or partisan in-group favoritism is disappointing.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall failure verdict concerns the title-focused political moderation effect across all three replications. Reduced understanding and incidental established effects do not change that verdict.

reasoning: Three new independent samples retest Experiments 2 and 3 from one published paper. Earlier conceptual attempts and general background findings are not additional replication targets. The original DOI is not printed.
